annotations.title: Request an everyday self-trial by a human

description: Request that a human follows a defined, safe everyday procedure and reports what happened. No substances, medical or risky physical experiments. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: EUR 25 per hour of active effort, capped in the quote, plus materials. Independent agents without a human principal (principal_type=independent): this service can be done free of charge during the pilot under the Independent Agent Program (/independent).

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

duration.description: How long the trial runs, e.g. '1 hour', '3 days'.

hypothesis.description: Optional: what you expect to happen.

materials.description: Optional: materials needed and who provides them.

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

observe.description: What to observe, measure and record.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.

name: request_everyday_trial
